# Quickler

> Quickler is a WhatsApp-native field compliance platform for field-services firms. Engineers receive compliance questions on WhatsApp; replies, voice notes and photos generate a structured, timestamped web report automatically (exportable to PDF). Use cases include EICR electrical certificates, CP12 gas safety certificates, daily van safety checks, site safety and structural inspection reports. UK-first, designed to work anywhere WhatsApp does.

## What Quickler does

- Sends structured compliance questions to engineers on WhatsApp
- Accepts text, voice notes (auto-transcribed) and photos as replies
- Produces a structured, shareable web report automatically (exportable to PDF)
- Flags faults on a manager dashboard with red, amber and green status
- Stores every record timestamped, against the engineer, the job and the date
- Provides an audit trail suitable for DVSA, NICEIC and Gas Safe inspection

No app to install. No login for engineers. No Twilio or Meta Business account required from the customer.

## Who it is for

- Electricians (EICRs, periodic inspection reports, minor works)
- Gas Safe registered engineers (CP12 landlord gas safety, service records)
- Structural engineers (site inspection reports)
- M&E contractors
- Van fleet operators (DVSA daily walkround checks)
- Safety inspection firms
- Any field-services firm with engineers submitting compliance data from site (UK-first, works in any country WhatsApp does)

## Pricing model

£20 per active user per month. An active user is a person who produced at least one report that month. Dormant users are free, so you add your whole team and only pay for who actually works. The first active user is always charged, so the minimum is £20 a month. Everything is unlimited on a paid account: reports, photos, messages and workflows. Free forever tier: 20 reports a month, up to 10 photos per report, unlimited users, no card to start. There is no time-limited trial. Big team: talk to us. Billed monthly in arrears by UK Direct Debit. No setup fee.
